source: Unmodified production renderer (desktop/src/index.html, production Cloud entry bundle, isolated preload) against local Firebase Auth/Firestore emulators (project demo-mingrx-site). All non-loopback requests blocked.
environment: Windows, Electron, six emulator accounts in separate isolated sessions; 1440x960 viewport at device scale factor 2.
content: Fictional profiles (Lia, Bruna Neves, Caio, davi, Marina, theo_) with Unsplash-licensed non-portrait avatars; community "Noite de Sexta" created through the app; messages and reactions written through the real SDK. Voice uses real WebRTC between the accounts with Chromium fake audio; the shared screen is the site hero illustration fed through the app screen-share pipeline. screenFps set to the app default (30) in the harness because fresh test profiles read 0.
transformation: 2880x1920 PNG captures resized to 2400px WebP q84; detail versions are rectangular crops of the same captures. No retouching or compositing.
